name: Glass cancel flow
oneLiner: a cancel subscription screen on glass lists what you lose; the pointer drifts to Cancel anyway, then a retention offer card rises over it as the screen dims, the big offer slams in, and the pointer presses Keep my plan: the button floods green with a check and a ring
say: when the speaker talks about stopping people from cancelling or churn ('right before they cancel, they get an offer', 'half of them stay'): cut in on 'cancel', the offer lands on the deal, the green press on 'they stay'; set offer and offerSub to the deal they describe
